summary: Phased credential sweep for international contractor cohort with conditional asset return and sealed-storage HDD policy
description:
Issue summary: Run a phased credential sweep and conditional asset retrieval for a batch of 18 international contractors whose offboarding windows span multiple countries. The sweep must coincide with sealed-storage handling for any removable media and follow the sealed-HDD escrow policy for contractors leaving in restricted regions.

Background: HR initiated end-dates for contractors in EMEA and APAC cohorts (group A & B) due to contract expirations. Recent audit flagged inconsistent asset receipts for previous batches and a missed KMS key rotation tied to contractor service accounts. Security requires: (1) verified identity confirmation before asset handback, (2) sealed-HDD chain-of-custody when applicable, (3) revocation of cloud console and VPN access only after evidence of asset return or documented exception.

Impact: If not executed carefully, risk of lingering privileged credentials, unreturned encrypted drives, and noncompliance with contractual data-handling clauses. Business impact: potential compliance tickets for legal and delayed contractor payroll clearance.

Scope: 18 contractors across UK, FR, SG, and AU regions; mix of laptop + removable HDDs (7 flagged removable drives). Affected systems: Okta, GSuite, AWS IAM roles, internal service accounts, company asset inventory.

Acceptance criteria: All contractor accounts either fully deprovisioned or placed into documented exception cases; KMS key access revoked from contractor principals; asset return recorded in inventory with photo evidence and sealed-HDD chain-of-custody documented in Confluence; open exceptions have SRE/Legal-approved mitigation and TTL assigned.

Runbook links: Sealed HDD procedure (Confluence), Asset receipt form (internal), HR offboard batch template (internal).
investigation_notes:
Initial reconnaissance: HR export received with contractor list and signed NDAs. Inventory cross-check showed 5 contractors previously marked 'returned' with no photo evidence. IAM audit shows two service accounts still granted read access to redwood-prod-s3 via an older role binding.

Hypotheses and actions taken:
- Hypothesis 1: Asset returns were recorded but photos not uploaded. Action: PS sent to site coordinators to request receipts.
- Hypothesis 2: Service accounts were not included in automated deprovision rule due to legacy naming. Action: Running inventory query and plan to add name patterns to deprov script.

Partial findings:
- KMS grants: contractor-batch-A had an explicit grant via role/contractor-data-reader; schedule to rotate associated key material at 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC.
- Networking: VPN sessions show no active connections for these contractors in last 7 days.

Dependencies: Legal sign-off for sealed-HDD cross-border shipping for FR -> UK returns. Slack thread created: #support-internal (link: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C05ABC123).
work_items: 1) Coordinate with HR to get missing photo evidence and signed handback forms. 2) Execute targeted deprovision script for legacy-named service accounts (test in staging). 3) Rotate KMS key and revoke contractor grants at scheduled window. 4) Arrange sealed-HDD pickup or escrow per region policy (Logistics vendor: SecureShip). 5) Update offboard automation to include legacy patterns and a 'pending asset' state. 6) Document exceptions and notify Finance for final payroll clearance.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Contractor requires laptop return but is remote with local customs restrictions (APAC). Mitigation: Use SecureShip certified pickup and create legal-approved exception if pickup infeasible.

Risk: KMS rotation causes transient service disruptions for systems that relied on contractor access keys. Mitigation: Verify no production job depends on contractor principals; run key rotation in low-traffic window and have rollback plan.

Risk: Delay in legal approval for cross-border sealed-HDD transport. Mitigation: Hold encrypted drives in regional escrow and revoke access until clearance obtained.
next_steps:
- 2026-03-12: Complete KMS rotation and revoke grants (Marco). - 2026-03-13: Confirm receipt photos for outstanding 5 contractors (HR liaison: Elena Morris). - 2026-03-14: Execute deprovision script in prod after 1h monitoring (SRE: Priya Desai). - 2026-03-15: Close exceptions or escalate to Legal/Finance.
